about: The range word under an out-of-range value (#26: never the range by colour alone). Run by GraphFixtureTest.range (Android, RangeState) and RangeFixtureTests (Mac, RangeState). Format: ../README.md, 'Range word'.

cases.name: low, no pill: says Low
very low
high
very high (its orange looks like low's red to protan / deutan eyes)
extremely high from its own bound
in range: nothing
very good range: nothing
the high limit is high (#181: a limit belongs to the range beyond it)
the low limit is low
the very low limit is very low
the very high limit is very high
just inside the limits: in range
just under the high limit: in range
Eat carbs already says the side in words
Take insulin already says the side in words
a carbs mute pill says what was done, not the range
a high side's mute pill
late but not struck (3 min): still says it
struck (6 min): grey, no range colour to back up
LO: the text already says it
HI: the text already says it
the person's high 200: 190 is in range
the person's low 80: 75 is low
the person's high 200 is high
